parts.text: What WebMCP tools are exposed on this page, and which in-stock wireless ANC audio products do you have under $300?

The page exposes 8 WebMCP tools: 7 imperative tools via navigator.modelContext.registerTool (search_products, get_product_details, add_to_cart, remove_from_cart, get_cart, apply_promo_code, checkout_order) and 1 declarative HTML form tool (update_shipping_form). Under $300 in-stock ANC audio products are AeroPulse Pro ANC Headphones (prod-101) at $249.00 and SonicBuds Lite Wireless Earbuds (prod-102) at $129.00.
Add 1 AeroPulse Pro ANC Headphones (prod-101) to my cart and apply promo code WEBMCP20. What is my discounted total?
